name: search-upload-limit
prompt: Customers get error E_UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE when they upload a file of exactly 10 MiB, and some files a little smaller than that are rejected too. The documented limit for document uploads is 10 MiB (10 x 1024 x 1024 bytes), and a file of exactly that size is allowed. Find where the limit is enforced and fix it. Other limits (such as avatars) must not change.
